The curve is also reasonably distributed: top-3 holders hold about 11%, bundled buys about 9%, and the completer share (33%) is not extreme. Nothing in the brief flags an airdrop dump, and the class is labeled ORGANIC.

The case is weak, though. Price is down 75% from its 30-minute high and 56% over 30 minutes. Sells nearly matched buys in the first two minutes after graduation (ratio 1.02), and the pool is thin at 48 SOL, so a $20 ticket faces 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost before any move. Recent 15-minute net flow of +3.9 SOL is small relative to the drawdown, and the 2-minute post-graduation volume was mostly absorbed without a sustained rally. Demand may persist, but the brief gives no evidence it will hold for the next 30-60 minutes.

Verdict: a marginal case at best. I would skip unless you have an independent reason to expect a rebound.
